== Summary ==
Prize deckbox for the Skirmish for Sidious GEMP event (Virtual Set 22).

* '''Source:''' [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/1158833953218760804 SWCCG Discord message], #cantina (3 October 2023)
* '''Date:''' posted 3 October 2023
* '''Description:''' PC XL deckbox with Palpatine artwork; the Skirmish for Sidious event (7 October 2023) awarded "PC XL Deckboxes corresponding to Event Character".
* '''Also supplied by:''' Bill Bisco, 22 November 2026 (same file). Used on [[Players Committee marketing]].
